overview: Bomb Defusal is a compact first-person timed station puzzle. Visit three ordnance stations and activate their wire-cutting steps in sequence before a repeating countdown reaches zero. The implemented challenge is route and interaction order rather than freeform wire selection.
rules: Activate station Alpha, then Beta, then Gamma.
Completing a station disables it and enables the next; disabled stations ignore interaction.
The countdown starts at ten and decreases every timer pulse. Reaching zero detonates the bomb and loses the match.
Activating Gamma after the first two stations completes the game.
controls: WASD/arrows move; mouse looks; Shift sprints; Space jumps; Ctrl crouches.
Approach and aim at an enabled control, then press E to interact.
Escape opens the native menu; F5/F9 quick-save/load in the stock client.
story: The scenario casts the player as an unnamed bomb defuser responding to a timed ordnance emergency. No named story characters or extended plot are documented.
characters_note: No named story characters are documented. The objects, markers and hazards shown here serve the game rules.
